source_input_delta.selection: Matches scripts/verify.py source_inputs policy: manifests/toolchain plus non-Markdown source, fixtures, assets, configs, scripts and CI inputs, excluding cache/build directories.

policy: Exclude version-control storage, Python bytecode caches, target/build outputs, dependency caches and generated distribution ZIPs; preserve project CI configuration and tracked ignore rules.
Exclude actual saved worlds, SQLite databases and WAL/SHM/journal sidecars, private local host exports, user-data trees, personal preferences and multiplayer resume/session capabilities.

Do not apply a blanket JSON/PEM/log exclusion: historical and final release reports/logs, prepared source fixtures, model manifests and explicitly synthetic TLS test fixtures are source deliverables and must remain.
Keep the original synthetic TLS fixture-key.pem; it is an existing test fixture, not a user credential. Do not include unrelated private keys.

Retain captured immutable gate logs/reports and explicitly selected public native evidence after final verification; do not include the private full native review worlds or temporary recovered databases.
Recompute the final source ZIP inventory after release evidence and current documents are finalized. The current new-file count is a point-in-time observation.
